406 pages, 32 unnumbered pages of plates : 24 cm "After an astonishing career-first in Scotland, and then over 27 years with Manchester United Football Club, Sir Alex Ferguson delivers Leading, in which the greatest soccer coach of all time will analyze the pivotal leadership decisions of his 38 years as a manager and, with his friend and collaborator Sir Michael Moritz, draw out lessons anyone can use in business and life to generate long-term transformational success. From hiring practices to firing decisions, from dealing with transition to teamwork, from mastering the boardroom to responding to failure and adversity, Leading is as inspiring as it is practical, and a go-to reference for any leader in business, sports, and life."--Provided by publisher Includes index Becoming yourself -- Recognising hunger -- Assembling the pieces -- Engaging others -- Setting standards -- Measuring people -- Focus -- Owning the message -- Leading not managing -- The bottom line -- Business development -- The relevance of others -- Transitions Includes bibliographical references and index
